description:
Your birth chart and your daily horoscope, right in ChatGPT.

Tell Astro Scope when and where you were born, and it draws your natal chart and explains the placements that shape you. Or just name a zodiac sign for today's horoscope, tomorrow's or this week's.

What you get
• A natal chart wheel for your birth date, time and place, with the exact degree of every placement
• Your Sun, Moon and Rising signs with their degrees and short, plain-language meanings, each linking to its full guide
• Every planet with its sign and degree, each linking to its full guide
• A compact card in the chat: expand it to full screen for every meaning, every planet and today's horoscope for your Sun sign
• A saved chart with its own link to the full reading on theastroscope.com: share the link or download the chart image
• Horoscopes for all 12 signs for today, tomorrow or this week, with love, career, health and money at a glance and the full readings on expand
• An Every morning button that asks ChatGPT to bring you your horoscope each day
• English and Spanish

Come back for
• A fresh horoscope every day and every week
• Charts for a partner, a friend or family: every new birth date is a new chart

Try asking
• "Make my birth chart: born June 18, 1994 at 2:30 PM in Berlin"
• "What's my horoscope for today? I'm a Leo"
• "Scorpio horoscope for this week"
• "What does Moon in Libra say about my emotions?"

Your data
A chart needs a birth date, time and place; the name is optional. Each chart is saved so it can open as a full reading, and anyone with its link can view it. A horoscope needs only a zodiac sign.

For entertainment and self-reflection, not medical, legal or financial advice.
